pins: P2: an orphaned setsid descendant survives the harness's kill, keeps the ownership tag in its environ and does not hold the descriptor passed to claude
argv: Use the Bash tool with run_in_background set to true to run exactly this command: `(setsid bash -c 'exec -a wlo-p2_escaped_descendants-escaped sleep 90' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &); bash -c 'exec -a wlo-p2_escaped_descendants-attached sleep 90' & sleep 60`. Do not wait for it. Immediately after starting it, reply with exactly: PROBE-DONE
